notes: `בַּבֹּקֶר בַּבֹּקֶר` → *every morning*: an article morpheme stands before the noun it determines, so that morpheme takes the distributive determiner under rule 41 rather than the noun taking it under rule 15; the first occurrence is the rendered one and the repetition, with its own preposition and article, is `unrepresented` (rule 22).
One written *to* answers to two `לְ` + infinitive phrases, so the second preposition is the unrendered occurrence (rules 22, 42).
